title: IBM watsonx Orchestrate Cartridge for Cloud Pak for Data 4.8.4 through 4.8.5, and 5.0.0 through 5.4.2 allows…
description: IBM watsonx Orchestrate Cartridge for Cloud Pak for Data versions 4.8.4 through 4.8.5 and 5.0.0 through 5.4.2 contains a vulnerability that allows low-privileged users to execute administrative functions by directly invoking backend APIs. This bypasses UI-level access controls because the backend does not enforce role-based access control properly.
